text:
noah: Pulled `ceres-6.1b-release.tar` for onboarding. License header: "Eval-only: no commercial serving, redistribution prohibited, attribution required." Can we: 1) run 4-bit quant experiments on infra, 2) host an internal-only inference endpoint, 3) invite 2 external partners under NDA for latency tests?

anya_legal: Eval-only usually allows internal quant and benching. External partner access often counts as distribution unless vendor permits. Need to request a scoped exception for time-limited NDA trials. Also confirm attribution wording for any public benchmarks.

mira_ml: Quant note: 4-bit increases hallucination on our QA set. We want to run A/B across qconfig variants and record outputs. Any restrictions on storing model outputs for eval?

anya_legal: Storing outputs for internal analysis is fine. If outputs include third-party copyrighted dataset snippets flagged in the model card, avoid publishing verbatim without clearance.

jon_prod: If vendor denies partner beta, can we do remote-only tests where partner hits our managed sandbox and we control artifacts? Vendor might accept that if explicitly time-boxed.

anya_legal: Yes, request a "managed-sandbox" amendment: partners may call our hosted endpoint, no model artifacts shared, audit logs retained, non-commercial, 30-day window. I'll draft and loop vendor-relations.

orch-bot: Ticket created ML-901: "ceres-eval-license-amend-request" assigned to @anya_legal and @vendor-relations.

noah: Thanks. Holding off on mass quant runs until amendment or go-ahead.
